lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a rectangular grid-like pattern on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light upper surfaces to shadowed lower edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dark, elongated silhouette consistent with a remora attached near the ventral insertion point of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Single high-intensity green pixel cluster located on the dorsal-anterior region of the head, contrasting with the surrounding grayscale/blue values.
